title: 离散组合任务开放配置修订审计
scope: 主表T035-T078及8个未入主表的候选家族；区分人类历史记录与AI/agent新结果。

strict_accepts.name: Covering design C(24,14,4)
strict_accepts.definition: 在24点集上选14元块，覆盖每个4元子集，最小化块数。
strict_accepts.human_baseline: 历史best-known上界23块，源于公开covering-design数据库/档案；本轮尚未提取该条具体作者和区块列表。2026年Lean项目将下界从19提高到20（AI辅助形式证明，非人类构造）。

best_known_interval.status: open per 2026-10 public Lean project; independently check latest archive before freeze

strict_accepts.verification_cost: 中；验证覆盖需枚举所有C(24,4)子集，区块数很小。
strict_accepts.risks: human upper witness attribution/blocklist not yet pinned; lower bound is AI-assisted Lean result; repository is a 2026 archived snapshot and dynamic old La Jolla links may be stale.
strict_accepts.reason: 目前有清楚的20–23非零区间；先补人类23-block witness artifact和作者/日期，再进入首批。

strict_accepts.name: Binary linear code minimum distance [68,15]
strict_accepts.definition: 在F_2^68的15维线性子空间中最大化最小汉明距离。
strict_accepts.human_baseline: Grassl BKLC表给出的best-known code距离至少24；数据库保留构造方法/日期。应下载当前条目的生成矩阵并在准入前独立重算重量枚举/验证方式。

best_known_interval.status: table entry at codetables.de; live row must be frozen

strict_accepts.verification_cost: 中高；生成矩阵有效性廉价，精确最小距离需处理2^15-1个非零码字。
strict_accepts.risks: live database changes; baseline generator and proof of upper bound must be versioned.
strict_accepts.reason: 固定具体参数，有2的距离差，输出矩阵可验证，优于已闭合的小码配置。

new_families_audited.name: Minimum order n_6(4) of a 4-chromatic girth-at-least-6 graph
new_families_audited.definition: 最小化4色数且无长度小于6圈的简单图顶点数。
new_families_audited.human_baseline: Exoo–Goedgebeur 2019给出66顶点显式见证；2026新文给64顶点见证，不能将新64说成人类baseline。
new_families_audited.verification_cost: 高；64图证书在2026论文中Lean核验，旧图需取得数据；证明最优仍需下界。
new_families_audited.reason: 这是确有新标量目标且与regular cage不同的开放配置；只用旧人类上界时有66-29 gap。

new_families_audited.name: Maximum edges in a k-critical n-vertex graph
new_families_audited.definition: 固定k,n，在色数为k且每个真子图(k-1)-可染色的图中最大化边数。

best_known_interval.status: no concrete finite row interval extracted

new_families_audited.reason: 论文明确家族未解并给渐近论证，但本轮未找到一个固定(n,k)的数值upper/lower和可下载图，不能只用NP-hard/open status。

new_families_audited.human_baseline: Kostochka–Stiebitz (2003)给k≥6通用下界；Dirac/Toft有显式构造。
new_families_audited.reason: 不与上项另拆成任务；本轮缺具体验证行。

new_families_audited.name: Minimum monochromatic triangles in q-edge-colourings of K_n
new_families_audited.definition: 固定n,q，最小化单色三角形总数。
new_families_audited.human_baseline: 2色Goodman精确公式；K6最小值2，为已解校准，不是开放纪录。

best_known_interval.status: no open finite row with verified gap found

new_families_audited.reason: 若只选多色渐近结论没有有限基线gap；与T043定义需清楚区分。

new_families_audited.name: Maximum Sidon set in [N]
new_families_audited.definition: 最大化整数区间内pair sums互异集大小。
new_families_audited.human_baseline: Singer构造；G(m)至28已知最优即推出N≤586的R(N)精确值。
new_families_audited.reason: 整数Sidon集合B2与Golomb ruler只差平移，是同一问题逆函数，不作为新增任务。

new_families_audited.name: Ordinary crossing number of complete bipartite graphs
new_families_audited.definition: 给定K_{m,n}，最小化任意平面拓扑画法中的交叉数。
new_families_audited.human_baseline: 旧综述报告一些K_{7,n}案例；2026资料页声称已证明Zarankiewicz公式。
new_families_audited.reason: 需要核实2026证明的出版和同行评审状态；不要引用过期K_{7,9}开放记录。

new_families_audited.name: Maximum edge-chromatic index of an n-vertex linear hypergraph
new_families_audited.definition: 固定n，在线性超图中最大化边色数。
new_families_audited.human_baseline: Erdős–Faber–Lovász猜想及Kang et al. 2023充分大n定理。

best_known_interval.status: specific residual n and explicit witness not identified

new_families_audited.reason: 不能以猜想被证明/NP-hard概述代替一个具体验证行。

new_families_audited.name: Minimum cardinality finite additive basis of order two for an interval
new_families_audited.definition: 固定目标区间[0,N]，最小化A子集整数使A+A覆盖[0,N]的元素数。
new_families_audited.human_baseline: 本轮未找到有版本控制的公开基集数据库和匹配上下界行。
new_families_audited.reason: 概念有名不等于有当前纪录；可能与有限加法覆盖/覆盖设计重叠，先别加目录。

new_families_audited.name: Perfect hash families PHF(N;k,v,t)
new_families_audited.definition: An N-by-k array over v symbols such that for every t-column subset, at least one row assigns pairwise distinct symbols to those t entries. For fixed k,v,t, minimize N; equivalently maximize k at fixed N,v,t.
new_families_audited.human_baseline: Walker II and Colbourn (2007) give an explicit PHF(5;10,3,3) construction (their figure/table and online PHF tables), with tabu-search and recursive/direct constructions reported. Their article describes the tables as best-known upper bounds and notes exact PHF numbers are generally unknown.

best_known_interval.status: concrete human witness verified in primary paper; exact minimum N for this row not verified

new_families_audited.verification_cost: Low; enumerate all 120 triples of columns and confirm at least one rainbow row for each.
new_families_audited.risks: The public table is from 2007 and is an upper-bound catalogue; no current row-specific best lower bound or full downloadable witness was captured in this audit. PHF is a construction/optimization family, not a Boolean existence task if scoring maximum columns or minimum rows.
new_families_audited.reason: Named, natural scalar and explicit human instance, but current open gap and witness artifact need row-level verification before use.

new_families_audited.name: d-disjunct / d-cover-free binary matrices
new_families_audited.definition: For fixed defective-item count d and number of columns n, minimize the number m of rows in a binary matrix such that no column is contained in the Boolean OR of any d other columns. This is the d-disjunct / superimposed-code / d-cover-free-family construction problem.
new_families_audited.human_baseline: Van den Berg, Candès, Chinn, Levin, Olcott and Sing-Long (PNAS 2013) table a 4-disjunct 64-by-400 construction, obtained by shortening a covering-design-derived code; they also table a 2-disjunct 44-by-1600 construction from a standard code. The article gives explicit constructions/references and matching table context.

best_known_interval.status: row-matched current lower bound not verified; 2013 paper reports general bounds and says constructions can be within factor two of lower bounds

new_families_audited.verification_cost: Medium/high; for all columns, check each target column against every d-subset of other columns, O(n^(d+1) m) naively; optimized bitset certificate checks are possible.
new_families_audited.risks: 2013 record table is application-motivated and may be stale; no exact contemporary best/lower interval or archived matrix artifact was confirmed for the chosen rows. Distinguish disjunct from the weaker separable property and from error-tolerant variants.
new_families_audited.reason: Has a natural numerical rows objective and concrete historical constructions; pending newer row-specific records and lower bounds.

new_families_audited.name: Global postage-stamp problem / extremal additive h-basis
new_families_audited.definition: Given k positive stamp denominations and a limit s stamps per envelope, maximize the consecutive range n_s(A) such that every integer from 1 through that range is expressible as a sum of at most s denominations (equivalently add zero and use exactly s summands). The classical unrestricted two-stamp task is n_2(k).

recommended_open_configuration.domain: unrestricted nonnegative denomination set; do not impose restricted-basis condition

new_families_audited.human_baseline: Kohonen (2015), arXiv:1503.03416, states unrestricted n_2(k) is known only through k=24; Sloane's OEIS A001212 records n_2(24)=212 and authorship/history. Kohonen separately enumerates all extremal restricted bases through k=47, with n*_2(47)=734 and explicit bases. Do not treat 734 as a baseline for unrestricted n_2(47). The GStamps public library (Colisson Palais, Dumas, Galan, Grenet, Maignan, Roche; 2026) implements local/global search and basis construction but this audit did not extract a verified best unrestricted k=25 witness/value from its benchmark files.

best_known_interval.status: open by sequence cutoff in 2015 source, but current human best-known numeric k=25 witness and bound need verification; no benchmark row yet

new_families_audited.verification_cost: Low for validating one basis range by enumerating all sums, but exact global maximality requires a substantial combinatorial search/proof; performance depends on k,s.
new_families_audited.risks: Unrestricted n_2(k) and restricted n*_2(k) are different. General values through 24 are solved; restricted values through 47 do not imply unrestricted values. New 2026 GStamps algorithms are useful but their reported constructed basis is not automatically an optimality result. This is distinct from T049's difference-basis objective.
new_families_audited.reason: A well-defined open named optimization problem and public human computation record; k=25 is the natural next general configuration, but freeze only after extracting a specific current human basis and numeric range from a primary artifact.

source_notes: Golomb/Sidon整数B2严格等价；不可参数拆成两任务。
La Jolla旧站迁移后，以CoveringRepository/Zenodo 2026归档为基准；IRSI表明确目前是快照比较且有作者未确认、覆盖数组旧值未筛后续文献等限制。
人类历史构造与AI/agent新结果必须分开记录；一个新agent construction不能抹去其此前human baseline。
没有足够资料支持新增8个符合严格open-gap门槛的任务；宁少勿用抽象渐近问题凑数。
